e.title_en: Sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing — not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, with both the numbers and the formula in this repository, and with three stated reasons for deliberately not scraping the official calculator plus an itemised list of what it deliberately does not cover

e.summary: 一个回答「**哪家瑞士医疗保险对你最便宜**」的**静态站点**：给一个邮编与出生年，再说自己很少看医生／定期看／正在持续治疗，它就把**你所在地区可选的每一家保险公司、每一种模式与每一档免赔额**全比一遍，**数据来自瑞士联邦公共卫生局的官方保费数据**；**其最值得记的一处是它把「依据」逐条摆在明处**——**逐字「Insurek **不卖任何东西、不导流给任何人、不存储任何东西**。**它不是建议：它是对公开数字做的算术，而数字与公式都在本仓库里**。」**；**而它把整个成本问题写成**一行算术****（逐字给出 `cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`），**并从这行式子里跑出两个可核对的结果**：**六档成人免赔额里**只有 300 与 2500 会赢**（**其余四档在任何地区、任何支出水平下都不会最便宜**），**以及在法律规定的给付完全相同的情况下，同一地区最便宜与最贵保险公司的年差可超过一千法郎**；**另有四处同一纪律**：**① 它逐字说明**为什么不抓取官方计算器****（**理由三条：为已经是 CSV 的数字去解析脆弱的 HTML／要跟着政府网站的每次改版走／会给一个公共服务增加负载**，**而结局是「得到完全相同的数字」**）；**② 它的 Scope 一节分**已覆盖**与**故意不覆盖****（**后者含未成年人、欧盟／EFTA 参保者的保费与州级保费减免，并逐字给出理由「规则不同，而处理得不好比不处理更糟」**）；**③ 它把**代码、数据、字体**三层许可分别写明**（**代码 GPL-2.0／数据为联邦公共卫生局开放使用并署名／仓库内每个字体各带一份许可文件**）；**④ 它的 ETL 三步用意大利语命名且含一步**逐行核对****（**`etl/scarica.py` 下载、`etl/costruisci.py` 生成、`etl/verifica.py` **把生成的 JSON 与联邦 CSV 逐行对照**）
e.summary_hk: 一個回答「**哪家瑞士醫療保險對你最便宜**」的**靜態站點**：給一個郵編與出生年，再說自己很少看醫生／定期看／正在持續治療，它就把**你所在地區可選的每一家保險公司、每一種模式與每一檔免賠額**全比一遍，**數據來自瑞士聯邦公共衛生局的官方保費數據**；**其最值得記的一處是它把「依據」逐條擺在明處**——**逐字「Insurek **不賣任何東西、不導流給任何人、不存儲任何東西**。**它不是建議：它是對公開數字做的算術，而數字與公式都在本倉庫裡**。」**；**而它把整個成本問題寫成**一行算術****（逐字給出 `cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`），**並從這行式子裡跑出兩個可核對的結果**：**六檔成人免賠額裡**只有 300 與 2500 會贏**（**其餘四檔在任何地區、任何支出水平下都不會最便宜**），**以及在法律規定的給付完全相同的情況下，同一地區最便宜與最貴保險公司的年差可超過一千法郎**；**另有四處同一紀律**：**① 它逐字說明**為什麼不抓取官方計算器****（**理由三條：為已經是 CSV 的數字去解析脆弱的 HTML／要跟着政府網站的每次改版走／會給一個公共服務增加負載**，**而結局是「得到完全相同的數字」**）；**② 它的 Scope 一節分**已覆蓋**與**故意不覆蓋****（**後者含未成年人、歐盟／EFTA 參保者的保費與州級保費減免，並逐字給出理由「規則不同，而處理得不好比不處理更糟」**）；**③ 它把**代碼、數據、字體**三層許可分別寫明**（**代碼 GPL-2.0／數據為聯邦公共衛生局開放使用並署名／倉庫內每個字體各帶一份許可文件**）；**④ 它的 ETL 三步用意大利語命名且含一步**逐行核對****（**`etl/scarica.py` 下載、`etl/costruisci.py` 生成、`etl/verifica.py` **把生成的 JSON 與聯邦 CSV 逐行對照**）
e.summary_en: A static site answering which Swiss health insurance costs you least: given a postcode and a year of birth, plus whether you rarely see a doctor, see one regularly or are in ongoing treatment, it compares every insurer, every model and every deductible available where you live, using the official premium data of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health; **its most notable feature is that it lays its basis out item by item** — verbatim, **it sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing, and it is not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, with both the numbers and the formula in this repository**; **it reduces the entire cost question to one line of arithmetic**, given verbatim as premium times twelve plus the minimum of spending and deductible plus the minimum of ten percent of the excess capped at 700, **and two checkable results fall out of that line**: of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win**, the four in the middle never coming out cheapest across every offer in a region and every level of spending, and **for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year**; **four further points follow the same discipline**: **first, it states verbatim why it deliberately does not scrape the official calculator**, with three reasons — parsing fragile HTML for numbers already published as CSV, carrying every redesign of a government site, and putting load on a public service — and with the outcome named as arriving at identical figures; **second, its scope section separates what is covered from what is deliberately not covered**, the latter including minors, premiums for people insured in the EU or EFTA, and cantonal premium reductions, with the verbatim reason that the rules differ and handling them badly would be worse than not handling them; **third, it declares three licence layers separately** — GPL-2.0 for the code, open use with attribution for the federal data, and a licence file alongside each bundled font; **and fourth, its three-step pipeline is named in Italian and includes a verification step that checks the generated JSON against the federal CSV row by row**
e.body:
**insurek-swiss-deductible**（仓库 `lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser`，站点名 Insurek）**是一份回答「哪家瑞士医疗保险对你最便宜」的静态站点**：**给一个邮编与出生年，再说自己很少看医生／定期看／正在持续治疗，它就把你所在地区可选的每一家保险公司、每一种模式与每一档免赔额全比一遍**，**数据来自瑞士联邦公共卫生局（FOPH／BAG）的官方保费数据**。**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可 **GPL-2.0**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 **JavaScript**（**⚠️ 而其自述为「Python app」，见标注 ⑦**）、仓库体量 10,388 KB、创建 2025-06-25、最后推送 2026-09-10、topics 为 `app`／`deductible`／`flask`／`franchise`／`insurance`／`python`／`switzerland`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 4,879 字节**；**仓库实测共 90 个条目（81 个文件、9 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把依据放在你能看见的地方——以及当条件本身不在那里时」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「依据在仓库里」说得最直接、也做得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「依据在本仓库里」被写成一句话，且前面是三个否定**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「Insurek **sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing**. **It is not advice: it is arithmetic on public numbers, and the numbers and the formula are both in this repository.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「不卖、不导流、不存储」三个否定各封掉一条常见的商业模式**（**卖保单／收转介费／收集用户数据**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这比「我们不收集数据」这种单句声明更硬**：**它同时说明了**它靠什么不赚钱****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「不是建议，是对公开数字做的算术」**——**⭐ 即**它把自己的输出**降格**为一个更窄的东西**（**⭐ 与第 343 轮 [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 的「刻意不提供保险建议」、[[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]] 的「技术保费而非家财险保费」同族**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「而数字与公式都在本仓库里」**——**⭐ 即**读者不需要相信它，**可以自己复算**；**⭐ 本词条**实测核实了这句话**：**其 `sito/assets/calcolo.js`（**意大利语「计算」**）存在**，**`sito/dati/` 下实测 **46 个条目**（**生成的数据**）**，**而 README 逐字指明该目录为**「generated; do not edit by hand」****；**④ **它另在开头逐字说明**四种语言**（**意大利语、德语、法语、英语**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **整个成本问题被写成**一行算术**，而两个结论直接从这行式子里跑出来**——**逐字为**：**「Under Swiss compulsory health insurance（**KVG/LAMal**）an adult pays three things: the premium, twelve times a year; their own costs up to the deductible they chose; and above that 10% of what follows, **capped at 700 francs a year**. **The benefits are fixed by law and identical at every insurer.** So the whole question of what a year costs is **one line of arithmetic**:」**，**随后逐字给出那行式子**：**`cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`**；**并逐字给出两个后果**：**「First, of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win** — across every offer in a region and every level of spending, **the four in the middle never come out cheapest**. Second, and larger: **for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「法律规定的给付在每家保险公司都相同」是这条式子成立的前提**——**⭐ 即**它先说明**为什么这个问题可以被化简成算术**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**最漂亮的一处推理压缩**：**把「选保险」化简为三笔钱的加法**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **六档免赔额里**只有两档会赢**——**⭐ 这是一个**非常强且可自行复核的结论****（**⭐ 且它给出了适用范围：「在任何地区、任何支出水平下」**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **第二个结论把关注点从免赔额转到**保险公司之间的价差****（**⭐ 即**同一法定给付、同一地区，年差可超过一千法郎**）；**④ **公式与常量都写出来了**（**`premium × 12`、`min(spending, deductible)`、**上限 700 法郎**的 10%**）**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它的运行方式被逐条写清，且「没有后端」是它的设计**——**逐字为**：**「**There is no application server, no database and no third-party request while anyone uses the site.** A Python script runs **once a year** on the maintainer’s machine, turns the federal data files into **static JSON**, and **that is the whole backend**. The browser downloads the index, the postcode table and **one** premium file — the one for the area the visitor lives in — **under 250 KB in total**, and **does the arithmetic itself**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三个「没有」**（**没有应用服务器、没有数据库、**使用期间没有任何第三方请求**）**——**⭐ 第三条是**隐私层面最实在的一条**：**不是「我们不存你的数据」，而是**使用期间根本不往外发请求****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「一年跑一次的 Python 脚本就是整个后端」**——**⭐ 即**后端被压缩成**一份每年更新一次的静态数据**；**③ ⭐⭐ **下载量被量化**（**索引 ＋ 邮编表 ＋ **只**那一个地区的保费文件，**合计不到 250 KB**）**——**⭐ 即**按地区切分数据**，**既省流量又不必把全国数据发到浏览器**；**④ ⭐⭐ **算术在浏览器里做**，**与 ① 的「公式在仓库里」互相印证****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字说明**为什么不抓取官方计算器**，并给出三条理由与一个结局**——**⭐ 这是本条与本轮同批 [[copart-salvage-dataset]] 的**正面反差**，值得并列阅读**：**逐字为**：**「This is the same source the federal premium calculator at **priminfo.admin.ch** is built on — **which is why Insurek does not scrape it.** **Scraping would mean parsing fragile HTML for numbers that are already published as CSV**, **carrying every redesign of a government site** and **putting load on a public service**, **to arrive at identical figures**.（Priminfo also has no JSON API for premiums: it is a server-rendered form.）」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三条理由分别属于**技术、维护与公共资源**三个层面****（**为已有 CSV 的数字解析脆弱 HTML／跟着政府改版走／给公共服务加负载**）**——**⭐ 而不是一句「不道德」**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **结局被点名**：**「得到完全相同的数字」**——**⭐ 即**抓取的**收益为零**，**代价是三条以上的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它另外说明了官方为何没有 API**（**是一个服务端渲染的表单**）**——**⭐ 即**它把「为什么只能抓或只能拿 CSV」的**技术前提**也写了出来**；**④ **⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「我们刻意不做某件技术上做得到的事」写得最完整的一处**：**动机、代价、收益与替代方案四样俱全**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **Scope 一节分「已覆盖」与「**故意不覆盖**」，且后者带理由**——**逐字为**：**「**Covered**: adults（26+）and young adults（19–25），every canton and premium region, every insurer and model, with and without accident cover, all six deductibles — including **the roughly 1 000 combinations out of 20 000 where an insurer does not offer one of them**.」**；**「**Not covered, deliberately**: **minors**（deductibles from 0 to 600, co-insurance capped at 350, family discounts — **different rules, and handling them badly would be worse than not handling them**），**premiums for people insured in the EU/EFTA**, and **cantonal premium reductions**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「故意不覆盖」这一节的标题就把**动机**写进去了**（**deliberately**）**——**⭐ 即**缺口不是遗漏而是选择**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未成年人那一条的理由逐字为**「规则不同，而处理得不好比不处理更糟」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题里**最实用的一句取舍说明**（**⭐ 与第 343 轮 [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 的「在处理真实客户数据之前先要加什么」同类**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **覆盖的粒度到了**组合级****（**「约 20,000 个组合中有约 1,000 个是某家保险公司不提供某一档免赔额」**）**——**⭐ 即**它把**缺失本身也计入了覆盖范围**；**④ **两项未覆盖各有其性质**（**法律规则不同**与**不在本数据集内**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **三层许可被分别写明，而字体那一层是**逐文件**的**——**逐字为**：**「**Licence** Code: GNU GPL-2.0, see `LICENSE`. **Data: Federal Office of Public Health, open use with attribution.**」**；**而本词条**实测其 `sito/fonts/` 下**另有两份字体许可文件**（**`LICENSE-EBGaramond.txt` 与 `LICENSE-Inter.txt`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **这是本会话**第二次**见到把「代码许可」与「数据许可」分开写**（**第一次是第 343 轮 [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]] 的 `code` → MIT／`data` → OGL v3 两枚并列徽章**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为「两处独立出现」使这个做法从**孤例**变成了**可称许的惯例****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **而它多出第三层：**字体**（**两份许可文件与字体同目录**）**——**⭐ 即**一个静态站点实际携带**三种不同来源的权利**，**它把三种都写在明处**；**③ ⭐⭐ **数据侧的许可被写成一句**完整的话**（**「开放使用并署名」**）**，**且点名了**权利人是联邦公共卫生局****。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 ETL 三步用意大利语命名，而第三步是**逐行核对****——**逐字为**：**「`etl/scarica.py` **downloads the federal source files**；`etl/costruisci.py` **turns them into the site’s JSON**；`etl/verifica.py` **checks the JSON against the federal CSV, row by row**」**；**「`sito/dati/` generated; **do not edit by hand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **`verifica.py` 把**生成的 JSON 与联邦 CSV 逐行对照****——**⭐ 即**转换步骤本身是被验证的**，**而**不是只验证最终页面**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「单元格级精确相等」同族**）；**② **三步各司其职且命名即其职责**（**scarica＝下载、costruisci＝生成、verifica＝核对**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **生成目录被标注**「不要手工编辑」**（**⭐ 即**手改一次就会在下次重建时丢失**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **更新节奏与自动化被写明，且自动化**只提议不提交****——**逐字为**：**「The data is refreshed **once a year, in late September**, when the FOPH approves the following year’s premiums. **A GitHub Action does the download, the rebuild and the verification, and opens a pull request when anything changed.**」**；**⭐ 而* 本词条**实测其工作流文件名为** `premi-nuovi.yml`（**意大利语「新保费」**）**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **自动化**开 PR 而不是直接提交****——**⭐ 即**变更需要人过一眼**；**② **更新时点与原因绑定**（**每年 9 月下旬，联邦批准次年保费之时**）**。**⑨ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **其历史一节逐字说明它**从哪来****（**「began as a Flask app that asked you to copy six premiums by hand out of Priminfo… **The arithmetic was right; the work was on you.**」**），**并说明 Python 的去向**（**「The Python survived — it just moved from serving requests to preparing data once a year.」**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这段是**「把一件事做小」的一个很干净的叙述**；**② **维护者笔记为**意大利语**（**`LEGGIMI.md`**，**即意大利语的「读我」**）**；**③ **本地运行方式写明为**必须起一个服务**（**逐字「A real server, not a double-click: the paths are absolute and `fetch` does not work from `file://`」**）。**⑩ ⭐ **insurek-swiss-deductible**（倉庫 `lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser`，站點名 Insurek）**是一份回答「哪家瑞士醫療保險對你最便宜」的靜態站點**：**給一個郵編與出生年，再說自己很少看醫生／定期看／正在持續治療，它就把你所在地區可選的每一家保險公司、每一種模式與每一檔免賠額全比一遍**，**數據來自瑞士聯邦公共衛生局（FOPH／BAG）的官方保費數據**。**實測 ★1、fork 0、許可 **GPL-2.0**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主語言 **JavaScript**（**⚠️ 而其自述為「Python app」，見標注 ⑦**）、體量 10,388 KB、創建 2025-06-25、最後推送 2026-09-10、topics 為 `app`／`deductible`／`flask`／`franchise`／`insurance`／`python`／`switzerland`**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**README 實測 4,879 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 90 個條目（81 個文件、9 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把依據放在你能看見的地方——以及當條件本身不在那裡時」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把「依據在倉庫裡」說得最直接、也做得最完整的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「依據在本倉庫裡」被寫成一句話，且前面是三個否定**：**「Insurek **sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing**. **It is not advice: it is arithmetic on public numbers, and the numbers and the formula are both in this repository.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「不賣、不導流、不存儲」三個否定各封掉一條常見的商業模式**（賣保單／收轉介費／收集用戶數據）——**⭐ 這比「我們不收集數據」這種單句聲明更硬：它同時說明了它靠什麼不賺錢****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「不是建議，是對公開數字做的算術」**（把自己的輸出降格為一個更窄的東西；與第 343 輪 brokerflow 的「刻意不提供保險建議」、uk-home-insurance-risk-map 的「技術保費而非家財險保費」同族）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐「而數字與公式都在本倉庫裡」**——**⭐ 本詞條實測核實了這句話：其 `sito/assets/calcolo.js`（意大利語「計算」）存在，`sito/dati/` 下實測 46 個條目（生成的數據），而 README 逐字指明該目錄為「generated; do not edit by hand」****；**④ 它另在開頭逐字說明四種語言**（意大利語、德語、法語、英語）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **整個成本問題被寫成一行算術，而兩個結論直接從這行式子裡跑出來**：**「Under Swiss compulsory health insurance（**KVG/LAMal**）an adult pays three things: the premium, twelve times a year; their own costs up to the deductible they chose; and above that 10% of what follows, **capped at 700 francs a year**. **The benefits are fixed by law and identical at every insurer.** So the whole question of what a year costs is **one line of arithmetic**:」**，**隨後逐字給出** **`cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`**，**並逐字給出兩個後果**（**「of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win** — across every offer in a region and every level of spending, **the four in the middle never come out cheapest**」** 與 **「**for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year**」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「法律規定的給付在每家保險公司都相同」是這條式子成立的前提**（它先說明為什麼這個問題可以被化簡成算術——**本輪四條裡**最漂亮的一處推理壓縮**：把「選保險」化簡為三筆錢的加法）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 六檔免賠額裡只有兩檔會贏**（一個非常強且可自行複核的結論，且給出了適用範圍「在任何地區、任何支出水平下」）；**③ ⭐⭐ 第二個結論把關注點從免賠額轉到保險公司之間的價差****；**④ 公式與常量都寫出來了**（`premium × 12`、`min(spending, deductible)`、上限 700 法郎的 10%）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其運行方式被逐條寫清，且「沒有後端」是它的設計**：**「**There is no application server, no database and no third-party request while anyone uses the site.** A Python script runs **once a year** on the maintainer’s machine, turns the federal data files into **static JSON**, and **that is the whole backend**. The browser downloads the index, the postcode table and **one** premium file — the one for the area the visitor lives in — **under 250 KB in total**, and **does the arithmetic itself**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 三個「沒有」**（沒有應用伺服器、沒有數據庫、**使用期間沒有任何第三方請求**）——**⭐ 第三條是隱私層面最實在的一條：不是「我們不存你的數據」，而是使用期間根本不往外發請求****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「一年跑一次的 Python 腳本就是整個後端」**（後端被壓縮成一份每年更新一次的靜態數據）；**③ ⭐⭐ 下載量被量化**（索引＋郵編表＋只那一個地區的保費文件，合計不到 250 KB，即按地區切分數據）；**④ ⭐⭐ 算術在瀏覽器裡做**，**與 ① 的「公式在倉庫裡」互相印證****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字說明為什麼不抓取官方計算器，並給出三條理由與一個結局**（**⭐ 這是本條與本輪同批 [[copart-salvage-dataset]] 的正面反差**）：**「This is the same source the federal premium calculator at **priminfo.admin.ch** is built on — **which is why Insurek does not scrape it.** **Scraping would mean parsing fragile HTML for numbers that are already published as CSV**, **carrying every redesign of a government site** and **putting load on a public service**, **to arrive at identical figures**.（Priminfo also has no JSON API for premiums: it is a server-rendered form.）」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 三條理由分別屬於技術、維護與公共資源三個層面**（而不是一句「不道德」）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 結局被點名：得到完全相同的數字**（抓取的收益為零，代價是三條以上）；**③ ⭐⭐ 它另外說明了官方為何沒有 API**（是一個服務端渲染的表單）；**④ 這是本站所收條目裡**對「我們刻意不做某件技術上做得到的事」寫得最完整的一處**：動機、代價、收益與替代方案四樣俱全**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **Scope 一節分「已覆蓋」與「故意不覆蓋」，且後者帶理由**：**Covered**（adults 26+、young adults 19–25、每個州與保費地區、每家保險公司與模式、含與不含意外保障、全部六檔免賠額——**including the roughly 1 000 combinations out of 20 000 where an insurer does not offer one of them**）；**Not covered, deliberately**（**minors**（deductibles from 0 to 600, co-insurance capped at 350, family discounts — **different rules, and handling them badly would be worse than not handling them**）、**premiums for people insured in the EU/EFTA**、**cantonal premium reductions**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「故意不覆蓋」這一節的標題就把動機寫進去了**（deliberately，即缺口不是遺漏而是選擇）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 未成年人那一條的理由逐字為「規則不同，而處理得不好比不處理更糟」**（本輪主題裡**最實用的一句取捨說明**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 覆蓋的粒度到了組合級**（約 20,000 個組合中有約 1,000 個是某家保險公司不提供某一檔免賠額——**把缺失本身也計入了覆蓋範圍**）；**④ 兩項未覆蓋各有其性質**（法律規則不同 vs 不在本數據集內）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **三層許可被分別寫明，而字體那一層是逐文件的**：**「**Licence** Code: GNU GPL-2.0, see `LICENSE`. **Data: Federal Office of Public Health, open use with attribution.**」**；**而本詞條實測其 `sito/fonts/` 下另有兩份字體許可文件**（`LICENSE-EBGaramond.txt` 與 `LICENSE-Inter.txt`）**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 這是本會話第二次見到把「代碼許可」與「數據許可」分開寫**（第一次是第 343 輪 uk-home-insurance-risk-map 的兩枚並列徽章——**兩處獨立出現使這個做法從孤例變成可稱許的慣例****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 而它多出第三層：字體**（兩份許可文件與字體同目錄，即一個靜態站點實際攜帶三種不同來源的權利，它把三種都寫在明處）；**③ ⭐⭐ 數據側的許可被寫成一句完整的話並點名了權利人**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 ETL 三步用意大利語命名，而第三步是逐行核對**：**「`etl/scarica.py` **downloads the federal source files**；`etl/costruisci.py` **turns them into the site’s JSON**；`etl/verifica.py` **checks the JSON against the federal CSV, row by row**」**；**「`sito/dati/` generated; **do not edit by hand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ `verifica.py` 把生成的 JSON 與聯邦 CSV 逐行對照**（轉換步驟本身被驗證，而不是只驗證最終頁面；與第 342 輪 ratecraft 的「單元格級精確相等」同族）；**② 三步各司其職且命名即其職責**；**③ ⭐⭐ 生成目錄被標註「不要手工編輯」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **更新節奏與自動化被寫明，且自動化只提議不提交**：**「The data is refreshed **once a year, in late September**, when the FOPH approves the following year’s premiums. **A GitHub Action does the download, the rebuild and the verification, and opens a pull request when anything changed.**」**；**⭐ 而本詞條實測其工作流文件名為 `premi-nuovi.yml`（意大利語「新保費」）**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① ⭐⭐ 自動化開 PR 而不是直接提交**（變更需要人過一眼）；**② 更新時點與原因綁定**。**⑨ ⭐ **其餘可核實細節**：**① 其歷史一節逐字說明它從哪來**（「began as a Flask app that asked you to copy six premiums by hand out of Priminfo… **The arithmetic was right; the work was on you.**」）**並說明 Python 的去向**（「The Python survived — it just moved from serving requests to preparing data once a year.」）——**⭐ 這是「把一件事做小」的一個很乾淨的敘述**；**② 維護者筆記為意大利語**（`LEGGIMI.md`）；**③ 本地運行方式寫明為必須起一個服務**（逐字「A real server, not a double-click: the paths are absolute and `fetch` does not work from `file://`」）。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 並讀**。

**insurek-swiss-deductible** (repository `lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser`, site name Insurek) **is a static site answering which Swiss health insurance costs you least**: **given a postcode and a year of birth, plus whether you rarely see a doctor, see one regularly or are in ongoing treatment, it compares every insurer, every model and every deductible available where you live**, **using the official premium data of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health**. **Measured ★1, 0 forks, licence **GPL-2.0** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language **JavaScript** (⚠️ **while its own description calls it a Python app — see ⑦**), a 10,388 KB repository, created 2025-06-25, last pushed 2026-09-10, topics `app`, `deductible`, `flask`, `franchise`, `insurance`, `python` and `switzerland`** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 4,879 bytes**; **the repository measures 90 entries (81 files, 9 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the basis should be placed where you can see it, and that the interesting case is when the terms themselves are not there**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states and delivers on having the basis in the repository most completely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Having the basis in the repository is one sentence preceded by three negatives** — **the most notable point in this entry**: verbatim, **Insurek sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing, and it is not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, with both the numbers and the formula in this repository** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **each of the three negatives closes off a familiar business model — selling policies, taking referral fees, and collecting user data — which is harder than a single claim of not collecting data, because it also says what it does not earn from**; ⭐⭐⭐ **"it is not advice: it is arithmetic on public numbers" demotes its own output to a narrower thing**, ⭐ **the same family as round 343’s deliberate refusal to give insurance advice and its "technical premiums rather than home insurance premiums"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and "the numbers and the formula are both in this repository" means a reader need not trust it but can recompute it — a claim this entry verified, since a calculation script exists under the site assets, 46 generated data entries sit under the data directory, and the README marks that directory as generated and not to be edited by hand**; **and the README opens by naming the four languages the site is offered in**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The entire cost question is reduced to one line of arithmetic, and two conclusions fall straight out of it** — verbatim, under Swiss compulsory health insurance an adult pays three things, the premium twelve times a year, their own costs up to the deductible they chose, and above that ten percent of what follows capped at 700 francs a year, and **because the benefits are fixed by law and identical at every insurer, the whole question of what a year costs is one line of arithmetic**, given verbatim as premium times twelve plus the minimum of spending and deductible plus the minimum of ten percent of the excess capped at 700; **with two consequences stated verbatim**: of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win**, across every offer in a region and every level of spending, the four in the middle never coming out cheapest, and **for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the premise that the law makes benefits identical is what licenses the reduction, so it first explains why the question can become arithmetic at all — the finest compression of reasoning this round produced, turning choosing insurance into adding three amounts**; ⭐⭐⭐ **only two of six deductibles ever winning is a strong and independently checkable conclusion, given with its scope of application**; ⭐⭐ **the second conclusion shifts attention from the deductible to the spread between insurers**; **and the formula and its constants are all written out**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ How it runs is stated item by item, and having no backend is the design** — verbatim: **there is no application server, no database and no third-party request while anyone uses the site; a Python script runs once a year on the maintainer’s machine, turns the federal data files into static JSON, and that is the whole backend; the browser downloads the index, the postcode table and one premium file, the one for the area the visitor lives in, under 250 KB in total, and does the arithmetic itself** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the three absences include no third-party request while in use, the most substantive of the three on privacy grounds, since it is not that they do not store your data but that nothing is sent out at all while you use it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **a Python script running once a year being the whole backend compresses the backend into a dataset refreshed annually**; ⭐⭐ **the download is quantified, and the data is split by region so that only one area’s file is fetched**; **and ⭐⭐ the arithmetic runs in the browser, corroborating the claim that the formula is in the repository**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It states verbatim why it deliberately does not scrape the official calculator, with three reasons and one outcome** — ⭐ **the direct contrast with this round’s salvage dataset entry**: verbatim, this is the same source the federal premium calculator is built on, **which is why Insurek does not scrape it — scraping would mean parsing fragile HTML for numbers that are already published as CSV, carrying every redesign of a government site, and putting load on a public service, to arrive at identical figures**, and the official calculator has no premium API because it is a server-rendered form ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the three reasons cover technique, maintenance and the public resource rather than a single appeal to ethics**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the outcome is named as arriving at identical figures, so the gain from scraping is zero while the costs are threefold**; ⭐⭐ **it also explains why the official source has no API, so the technical premise of the choice is given**; **and it is the most complete account this site has collected of deliberately not doing something that is technically possible: motive, cost, benefit and alternative all present**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its scope section separates what is covered from what is deliberately not, with reasons** — covered: adults and young adults, every canton and premium region, every insurer and model, with and without accident cover, all six deductibles, **including the roughly one thousand combinations out of twenty thousand where an insurer does not offer one of them**; not covered deliberately: **minors, whose deductibles, co-insurance cap and family discounts follow different rules, with the verbatim reason that handling them badly would be worse than not handling them**, premiums for people insured in the EU or EFTA, and cantonal premium reductions ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the heading itself carries the motive, so a gap is a choice rather than an omission**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the reason for excluding minors is the most practical statement of a trade-off in this round**; ⭐⭐ **coverage is specified down to combinations, counting absences within the covered range itself**; **and the two exclusions differ in kind, one being different legal rules and the other being outside this dataset**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Three licence layers are declared, and the font layer is per file** — verbatim, the code is GPL-2.0 and the data is the Federal Office of Public Health’s under open use with attribution; **and this entry measurably found two further licence files alongside the bundled fonts** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **this is the second time in this session that a code licence and a data licence have been declared separately, the first being round 343’s two parallel badges, and two independent occurrences move the practice from a one-off to something that can be commended**; ⭐⭐⭐ **it adds a third layer, fonts, with a licence file beside each, so a static site carries three different sources of rights and states all three**; **and ⭐⭐ the data licence is a complete phrase naming the rights holder**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its three-step pipeline is named in Italian and its third step verifies row by row** — verbatim, one script downloads the federal source files, one turns them into the site’s JSON, and one **checks the JSON against the federal CSV row by row**, with the generated directory marked as generated and not to be edited by hand ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the conversion step is itself verified rather than only the final page, the same family as round 342’s cell-level exact equality**; **the three steps have names that state their jobs**; **and ⭐⭐ hand-editing the generated directory is warned against because it would be lost on the next rebuild**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ The refresh cadence and automation are stated, and the automation proposes rather than commits** — verbatim, the data is refreshed once a year in late September when the office approves the following year’s premiums, and **a GitHub Action does the download, the rebuild and the verification and opens a pull request when anything changed**; ⭐ **and this entry measurably found the workflow file named in Italian as "new premiums"** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **opening a pull request rather than committing means a change needs a human look**; **and the timing is tied to its cause**. **⑨ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **the history section states where it came from, a Flask app that asked you to copy six premiums by hand out of the official calculator, with the line that the arithmetic was right and the work was on you, and where the Python went, having moved from serving requests to preparing data once a year**, ⭐ **a clean account of making a thing smaller**; **the maintainer’s notes are in Italian**; **and local running is stated to require a server, since the paths are absolute and fetching does not work from a file URL**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with** [[uae-health-pricing-model]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[lossratio-r]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[insurance-qa-evidence]], [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]], [[copart-salvage-dataset]], [[kokuho-rules-engine]] and [[medical-opinion-extractor]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ Licence measured as GPL-2.0 for the code** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present and the README states the code licence verbatim**; ⭐ **but the data carries its own statement and the fonts carry two further licence files, so the repository is not claimed to have a single licence status**, ⚠️ **and none of the three layers’ terms was read in full, so all three should be confirmed separately before use, modification or redistribution**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the site was run** — **nothing was cloned, no Python environment was created, no script under the pipeline directory was run, no workflow was run and the live site was not opened**; **so its comparison results, the correctness of that one line of arithmetic, the conclusion that only two deductibles ever win, and the under-250-KB figure are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and that every file it names exists**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the calculation script really implements that one line, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether the verification script really checks row by row against the federal CSV; and whether the 46 generated data entries really come from the federal data**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its premium data really comes from the office’s official dataset was not verified** (**the README names the open-data dataset and two further federal files, but ⚠️ that dataset was not visited and no premium value was compared**). **⑤ ⚠️ Its claim of no third-party request while in use was not verified** (⭐ **a checkable engineering claim, ⚠️ but no network observation was made and its page scripts were not read**). **⑥ ⚠️ Its claim of storing nothing was not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️⚠️ One inconsistency between the description and the technical detection is stated plainly**: **the repository description calls it a Python app while the detected primary language is JavaScript** — ⭐ **no claim is made that this is an error, since the README itself says Python runs only in the extraction stage and the site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript**, ⚠️ **but a reader seeing only the description would take it for a Python application**; ⭐ **a grammatical blemish in the description is also recorded, without comment**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its comparison constitutes anyone’s best choice** (⭐ **its own README states verbatim that it is not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, and it lists the three things it deliberately does not cover**). **⑨ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its 46 generated data entries are in step with the federal data, and which year they cover, was not verified**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and the site’s usage were not verified**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★1 with 0 forks**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README measures only 4,879 bytes and yet gives in one page a complete cost formula, two checkable conclusions, an itemised exclusion list with reasons, three licence layers, a three-step pipeline including a row-by-row check, and a short history — very short documentation carrying very high information density**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑫ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2025-06-25** — ⭐ **recorded as such, its selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-10)**. **⑬ ⚠️ The documentation is in English while the code directories, script names and maintainer’s notes are in Italian** — ⚠️ **the site itself is offered in four languages, but the repository’s comments and notes are mainly Italian**. **⑭ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence GPL-2.0, stars, forks, language JavaScript, size, created/pushed dates, topics and description); the 4,879-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, and the entry quotes its three negatives, its formula and two results, its runtime, its no-scraping reasons, its scope section, its three licence layers, its pipeline and its history; **all 90 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**81 files, 9 directories; the entry used this to check the three pipeline scripts, the five site asset files, the two font licence files, the workflow file, the maintainer’s note and the 46 generated data entries**); **nothing was cloned, no script or workflow was run, the live site was not opened, no source contents were read, the federal data source was not visited, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.
